LanguageData.NSIF_MasterSwitchDesc: Master switch for all refrigerator beds. Per-refrigerator choices are preserved while disabled.
LanguageData.NSIF_AllowUfGarbageBin: Allow UF Light Industries Furniture garbage bins as refrigerators
LanguageData.NSIF_AllowUfGarbageBinDesc: Allow UF Light Industries Furniture garbage bins to function as refrigerator beds. Disabling this hides their sleep command and disables their bed, capacity, and recovery effects.
LanguageData.NSIF_IcyCoreRecoveryDesc: Nivarians resting in a powered refrigerator bed recover Icy Core at the base rate of a Nivarian bed.
LanguageData.NSIF_IcecreamTailRecoveryBoostDesc: Nivarians resting in a powered refrigerator bed recover an immature Icecream Tail faster. Requires the Icecream Tail mod.
LanguageData.NSIF_CapacityReductionDesc: Reduce refrigerator capacity while its bed is enabled. Disable this to make all refrigerator beds use no storage capacity.
LanguageData.NSIF_SingleBedMaximumReductionDesc: A single refrigerator bed still halves capacity, but cannot reduce it by more than this value. Set this to 0 to use no capacity.
LanguageData.NSIF_DoubleBedMaximumReductionDesc: A double refrigerator bed still halves capacity, but cannot reduce it by more than this value. Set this to 0 to use no capacity.
LanguageData.NSIF_AllowSleepingDesc: Allow colonist Nivarians to use this refrigerator as a bed.
LanguageData.NSIF_MasterSwitchDisabled: Refrigerator sleeping is disabled in mod settings.
LanguageData.NSIF_OnlyNivarianColonists: Only colonist Nivarians can sleep here.
LanguageData.NSIF_InteractionMoodDesc: Storing or taking items affects the sleeper and the interacting pawn while a Nivarian sleeps inside.
LanguageData.NSIF_SleepMoodDesc: Nivarians sleeping in a refrigerator bed gain an additional thought based on its available space.
LanguageData.NSIF_DebugLoggingDesc: Log first-time container Def checks, results, matching reasons, and refrigerator cache changes.
LanguageData.NSIF_DebugNoticeDesc: Show the refrigerator cache quick-debug notice once when you next enter a colony. It disables itself after being shown.
LanguageData.NSIF_DebugNoticeLetterLabel: Nivarian refrigerator beds may need debugging
LanguageData.NSIF_DebugNoticeLetterText:
Nivarians Can Sleep! In! Refrigerators! has been updated, and its refrigerator detection logic has changed. Instead of scanning everything once when the game loads, the mod now checks each newly built storage container, determines whether it is a refrigerator, and caches the result. Because of this change, some refrigerator beds may disappear or fail to be recognized.
Open this mod's settings, go to the Debug tab, and click “Quick debug”. This performs a one-click repair and caches every storage container on the current colony map.
Please note that this option may not fix every case. If a refrigerator still cannot be registered afterward, please report it to me and I will fix it as soon as possible.
LanguageData.NSIF_VerboseCacheLoggingDesc: Also log every positive or negative cache hit. This may produce a large amount of log output.
LanguageData.NSIF_QuickRepairDesc: Scan every storage container on the current map, cache its Def, and immediately attach missing components to refrigerator instances.
LanguageData.NSIF_QuickRepairUnavailable: Enter a map before running quick repair.
LanguageData.NSIF_QuickRepairResult: Quick repair complete: scanned {0} containers, checked {1} new Defs, found {2} refrigerators, repaired {3} instances, and encountered {4} failures.
